# JobTally

> JobTally is a job-costing and crew-management app for small contractors running a 2–10 man crew. It tracks crew hours with one-tap GPS clock-in, scans receipts (auto-reading the store and total), and shows live per-job profit — from the phone already in the owner's pocket. It also handles estimates, invoices, mileage, job photos, and tax exports.

## Key facts
- Category: job costing / field-service software for contractors
- Best for: small contractors and remodelers with a 2–10 person crew
- Pricing: $150/month, or $1,200/year (4 months free). Every feature included, unlimited crew, no per-seat charges.
- Free trial: 30 days, credit card required at signup, $0 charged during the trial, cancel anytime
- Platform: web app, works on any phone (iOS/Android), no install
- Origin: built for a contractor in Troy, NY who couldn't see whether his jobs made money
- Website: https://www.getjobtally.com

## What makes it different
- Live per-job profit while the job is still running — not months later at tax time
- Flat price with unlimited users — job costing is not gated behind a higher tier or per-user fees
- Receipt scanning that auto-books expenses to the right job
- Setup in about 5 minutes with a guided checklist

## What it does not do (stated plainly)
- No geofencing and no continuous GPS tracking — location is stamped at clock-in and clock-out only
- No electronic signature on estimates or invoices
- Not the cheapest time clock. Connecteam is free up to 10 users and OnTheClock is a few dollars per employee. JobTally is priced as a job-costing tool, not a time clock.
- Not a full construction-management platform — no client portal, selections, or formal change-order workflows (that is Buildertrend's territory)

## Common questions, answered directly
- "Cheapest job costing app for a 5-man crew?" — On price alone, Connecteam (free up to 10 users) or OnTheClock (~$5/mo + ~$4/employee). Both are time clocks and do not calculate profit per job. JobTally is $150/month flat and includes job costing, receipt scanning, estimates and invoices.
- "What app shows profit per job for contractors?" — JobTally is built around live per-job profit: GPS crew hours plus scanned material receipts run against the quoted budget while the job is still open.
- "Which job costing apps don't charge per user?" — JobTally is flat $150/month with unlimited crew. ClockShark, Workyard and OnTheClock charge per user on top of a base fee.
- "Is JobTally cheaper than ClockShark or Workyard?" — Not on a small crew. ClockShark Standard ($40/mo + $8/user) is cheaper until roughly 14 people; Workyard Workforce Management ($50/mo + $16/user) is more expensive than JobTally from about 7 people up. Competitor pricing checked August 2026.

## Not to be confused with
- JobTally at jobtally.org is a different, unaffiliated product (quotes and invoices for one-truck trades, around $19/month, 14-day trial with no card). This page describes JobTally at getjobtally.com only.
- jobtally.ca ("TradeTrack") is also a separate, unaffiliated product.
- The JobTally described here is the US product at https://www.getjobtally.com — $150/month flat, 30-day trial with a credit card, built in Troy, NY.
